info.name: TIB-5424 — GET order-items khong tra pickup items (staging)
info.description:
Bo test API cho **TIB-5424 — Update app for Shopify "ship and pickup in one order"** (project TIB tren Testlane/Jira).

## Bug dang kiem tra (comment dev, 2026-09-28)
> api GET /order-items khong tra ve pickup items nua, tat ca cac trang o bulk fulfill deu khong hien pickup item.

Theo thiet ke ban dau cua TIB-5424 (comment 51222): item pickup **duoc phep hien thi** (co tag "Pickup"), chi bi **chan khi fulfill**. Bug nay (neu dung) la mot **regression rong hon**: pickup item bi loai ngay tu buoc liet ke/GET, khong con la vi tri bi chan khi fulfill nua. Bo nay CHI kiem tra phan GET/liet ke (hien thi), khong test lai phan chan fulfill (da co trong scope goc cua TIB-5424).

## Moi truong & endpoint
- Portal API (noi bo, JWT): `{{baseUrl}}/api/instances/{instanceId}/order-items` — endpoint duoc dev nhac toi, nghi la endpoint cac trang Bulk Fulfill goi (**chua verify qua network tab, can xac nhan**).
- Public/Partner API: `{{baseUrl}}/openapi/v1/orders`, `/openapi/v1/orders/{orderId}` — khong co `/order-items` rieng, item (neu co) nam long trong response order. Kiem tra de biet bug co lan sang API doi tac hay khong.
- Base: `https://staging-api.teeinblue.com` (dung chung 1 host cho ca hai, giong TIB-031).

## Du lieu can chuan bi TRUOC khi chay (chua co san trong repo nay)
TIB-5424 yeu cau mot **Shopify Plus dev store co feature preview "Ship and pickup in one order"** — day KHONG phai `instance_id_1` (linh-tib-staging) va cung KHONG chac la `instance_id_2` (linh-tib-checkout, Plus nhung tao truoc khi co feature preview nay, chua xac nhan co bat duoc feature preview nay hay khong).

Theo comment TIB-5424 (Step 1-5): tao dev store moi + bat feature preview + bat local pickup + dat 1 order gom **1 item chon Ship + 1 item chon Pickup**. Sau khi co store nay, dien vao **collection variables**:
- `instanceId` — instance id tren teeinblue cua store do
- `orderId` — internal order id (teeinblue) cua order hon hop
- `platformOrderId` — Shopify order id/name cua order do (dung cho public API)
- `shippedOrderItemId` — id noi bo cua item chon SHIP (control, luon phai xuat hien)
- `pickupOrderItemId` — id noi bo cua item chon PICKUP (item dev bao bi mat)

Lay `shippedOrderItemId` / `pickupOrderItemId` bang cach mo trang Bulk Fulfill / Order detail tren Portal, doc id item tu network tab hoac tu DOM (Devtools).

## Diem chua chac chan — CAN DEV/PO XAC NHAN (khong tu suy dien)
1. Ten field JSON danh dau item la pickup (vi du `delivery_method`, `requires_shipping`, `fulfillment_type`...) — hien khong co spec/example luu trong repo.
2. Endpoint `GET /api/instances/{id}/order-items` co chinh xac la endpoint Bulk Fulfill goi khong, hay Bulk Fulfill dung endpoint khac.
3. Public API co expose thong tin item-level delivery method/pickup hay khong (co the hoan toan khong co, thi day la N/A chu khong phai bug).

Cac test duoi day duoc thiet ke de KHONG phu thuoc vao cau tra loi cho 3 diem tren: assert theo **id item** (giong pattern da dung trong TIB-031), va log full raw JSON de doi chieu bang mat / gui cho dev.

## Cach chay
1. Chon environment **TIB Staging — Open API** (goc tren ben phai). Environment nay giu san `partnerToken`, `ordersReadToken`, `baseUrl`.
2. Dien 5 collection variable o tren (`instanceId`, `orderId`, `platformOrderId`, `shippedOrderItemId`, `pickupOrderItemId`) va `userA_email`/`userA_password`.
3. Chay folder **0. Setup** truoc (lay JWT + sanity check instance).
4. Chay folder **1** (Internal API) va **2** (Public API).

## Luu y
- **JWT staging chi song 15 phut.** Thay 401 hang loat thi chay lai `Setup — Login`.
- Cloudflare chan User-Agent la (403, error 1010) — moi request da co header `User-Agent` gia trinh duyet, dung xoa.
- day la bo test **chan doan** (diagnostic) hon la bo test **khang dinh** — vi con nhieu diem chua duoc dev/PO xac nhan (xem muc tren). Ket qua PASS/FAIL tu cac test id-based van co gia tri, nhung dung dung mot minh de dong bug — doi chieu voi cau tra loi cua dev cho 3 diem chua chac chan.

item.name: 1. Internal API — GET order-items (endpoint duoc cac trang Bulk Fulfill goi)
item.description:
Theo comment dev cap nhat 2026-09-28 tren TIB-5424: `GET /order-items` khong con tra ve pickup items, khien tat ca cac trang Bulk Fulfill khong hien pickup item. Day la endpoint noi bo `GET /api/instances/{id}/order-items` (da xac nhan ton tai va co filter created_at trong TIB-031).

**Chua xac nhan**: ten field nao trong response danh dau item la "pickup" (co the la `delivery_method`, `requires_shipping`, `fulfillment_type`, ten khac, hoac hoan toan khong co field rieng ma phai suy tu quan he voi Shopify Fulfillment Order). Cac request duoi day KHONG assert theo field do — chi assert theo id cua item (giong pattern TIB-031), va log raw JSON cua item dau tien de doi chieu bang mat / hoi dev.

**Can dev/PO xac nhan truoc khi chot bug**: exact field pickup (neu co), va endpoint nay co dung la endpoint cac trang Bulk Fulfill goi hay khong (chua verify qua network tab).

item.name: 2. Public/Partner API — GET /orders, /orders/{orderId} (kiem tra anh huong tuong tu)
item.description:
Public API (`{{baseUrl}}/openapi/v1/...`) khong co endpoint `/order-items` rieng — order items (neu co) duoc long trong response cua `/orders` va `/orders/{orderId}`. **Chua co spec/example response duoc luu lai trong repo nen chua chac cau truc field cua line item trong public API** — cac request duoi day log toan bo raw response de doi chieu bang mat, va chi assert "cung" (indexOf) cho id/order thay vi assert cung mot field cu the.

Muc tieu: xac nhan bug tuong tu (thieu pickup item) co xay ra o public API hay khong, vi partner tich hop co the doc order qua API nay thay vi Portal.
